items.title: Turkey tightens hedge fund rules amid concerns over market manipulation
items.summary: Investing.com -- Turkey’s markets regulator tightened rules governing hedge funds on Saturday, introducing limits on concentrated investments and related-party exposure amid concerns over unusual market returns, Bloomberg reported.

items.title: Hotel Sales Jump 28% as Buyers Take On Renovations
items.summary: Hotel sales climbed 28% year over year in the first half as buyers took on capital-heavy properties and luxury demand stayed strong.

items.title: Michael Saylor Faces Fresh Funding Threat on MSCI-Exit Risk
items.summary: A rebound in Bitcoin has brought some relief for Michael Saylor’s Strategy Inc. But just as market pressure begins to ease, an old threat from index provider MSCI is resurfacing.

items.title: MSCI’s Elevated 2026 Expense Outlook Might Change The Case For Investing In MSCI (MSCI)
items.summary: Earlier this year, MSCI Inc. raised its 2026 operating expense forecast, citing acquisition costs, higher employee incentives, and stepped-up investment spending. This higher cost outlook has prompted fresh questions about near-term profitability even as many analysts still view the company’s long-term prospects positively. items.title: Senior Housing Buyers Are Paying Up, But Sellers Still Need Convincing
items.summary: Rising investor demand meets limited supply, boosting senior housing prices.

items.title: Data Center Deals Propel July CRE Sales Volume To Best Performance Since 2005
items.summary: CRE transactions reached their highest level since 2005, with BlackRock's acquisition of Aligned Data Centers driving activity.

items.title: Dollar Debasement Frees Emerging-Markets Currencies From Treasuries’ Weight
items.summary: US Treasuries and emerging-market currencies are diverging the most in more than four years as higher US yields fail to fuel the dollar’s strength like they once did.

items.title: Are Wall Street Analysts Bullish on MSCI Stock?
items.summary: Although MSCI has underperformed relative to the broader market over the past year, Wall Street analysts maintain a strongly optimistic outlook about the stock’s prospects.
